name: mshwar
description: Mshwar — AI-Powered Lebanon Trip & Experience Platform

scripts.build: pnpm --filter web build && pnpm --filter api build
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter web lint && pnpm --filter api lint
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter web typecheck && pnpm --filter api typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter web test && pnpm --filter api test && pnpm tokens:test
scripts.clean: pnpm --filter web clean && pnpm --filter api clean && rm -rf node_modules
